quick_tips_en: Always start with Bonjour Madame/Monsieur — Parisians respond much better
The Navigo Easy (rechargeable card) is cheaper than single tickets if you take more than 2 trips a day
Major museums (Louvre, Orsay) sell out online weeks ahead — always book in advance
Brasseries and bistros serve food outside standard meal times — handy if you arrive late
Outer districts (beyond the Peripherique) have limited metro access — plan journeys carefully

foods.name: Steak-Frites
foods.description: Bistecca alla griglia o in padella servita con patatine fritte e spesso salsa al burro o al pepe, classico delle brasserie parigine. È semplice ma tecnico: carne succosa, patate croccanti, cottura precisa e atmosfera da bistrot contano allo stesso modo. La salsa deve sostenere la carne senza appesantire il piatto.
